paragraphs: R' Yanta bar Hinena. Mentioned in Pesachim, beginning of chapter 4.[^1][^2]

notes.text: רפ״ד means beginning of chapter 4 in this citation. It is not “end of chapter 4” or daf 84a; the terminal period is not an amud marker after a chapter label. No named edition is independently verified.
The supplied patronymic is חיננא; an earlier heading audit had הינגא. Yanta and Hinena are provisional vocalizations. The abbreviated title remains R'.
